WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT 'orders_total' k, COUNT(*) a, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) b, NULL c FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'fulfil_'||COALESCE(fulfilment_type,'NULL')||'_'||status, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), NULL FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY fulfilment_type, status
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_total', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_dup', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), NULL FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatched_no_lines', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM fact_web_order o WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_web_nostore900', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s1 ON s1.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s1.store_id=900 AND s2.store_id<>900
ORDER BY 1;

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) n, MIN(sales_line_id) mn, MAX(sales_line_id) mx, MIN(etl_loaded_at) e1, MAX(etl_loaded_at) e2,
         COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) nets, MIN(sale_date) d1, MAX(sale_date) d2, MIN(store_key) sk
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) dup_keys, SUM(n) rows_, MIN(d1) mind, MAX(d2) maxd, MIN(e1) mine, MAX(e2) maxe, SUM(CASE WHEN nets=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id IN (dups.mn, dups.mx)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_returns
FROM dups JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=dups.sk GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20;

WITH ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) ctl_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) ctl_before, SUM(r.returns_net) ctl_ret
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1),
lines_by_store AS (
  SELECT o.fulfilment_type ft, s.store_id sid, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'ctl' k, CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR) a, ctl_net b, ctl_before c, ctl_ret d FROM ctl
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines', ft, sid, n, amt FROM lines_by_store
ORDER BY 1,2;
